R-30 at a glance

The R-30 is a compact, tethered underwater inspection ROV. Manufacturer figures: 21 kg vehicle weight, 300 m depth rating, 3 kg payload and a 1080p camera with 4× optical zoom and ±90° tilt. It suits visual inspection of dams, intakes and submerged structures where small size and easy handling matter.

FAQ

R-30 questions.

What is the depth rating of the R-30?

The manufacturer brochure lists a 300 m depth rating for the R-30 vehicle. The usable working depth also depends on the tether length, sensors and site conditions of the supplied configuration.

What can the R-30 carry?

The brochure lists a 3 kg payload. Typical additions are imaging sonar, positioning or a light tool; each must be confirmed for mounting, power and vehicle balance.

R-30 or R-45?

Choose the R-30 when access and handling are the main constraints and the sensor package is light. Choose the R-45 when you need the higher 8 kg payload for additional sensors or tools.

How do I get a price for the R-30?

Price depends on the configuration: sensors, tether length, tools and support equipment. Send a short project brief or email us, and we will reply with the questions needed for an itemised quotation.
